sensors.name: left light sensor LLIGHT, as percent

control_flow: followLine: if the left light sensor reads below 50 %, curve left; else curve right.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 50 %

branches.outcome: the light is below 50 % (in dim light, a tunnel): it curves left
the light is 50 % or more (in the open): it curves right

input_dimensions.dimension: the light from above at the robot
the light from above at the robot

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it always curves right (left wheel 40 %, right 10 %)
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line in bright light
scenarios.title: Follows the line in bright light
assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end

scenarios.coded_response: In dim light it always curves left (left wheel 10 %, right 40 %)
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line inside a tunnel, in dim light
scenarios.title: Follows the line in dim light
assumptions: A line that runs through a tunnel should be followed too.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line through the dark

uncertainties: You said follow the line, but no block reads the line tracker: the program only reads the left light sensor, so a line on the floor changes nothing for it.
Dim light only exists inside a tunnel, so the 'below 50 %' outcome can only happen in a tunnel.
You didn't say where the line ends or what the robot should do there.

planned: Follows the line through the tunnel

outcomes.words: the condition doesn't hold: the else part runs
planned: In the light, it follows the line to the goal

worlds.name: A line to follow in the light

tests.name: In the light, it follows the line to the goal
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts on the line at A in bright light, when the program runs, then it follows the line and reaches Goal 1 at its end.

equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: A, in the open, with no tunnel anywhere near: the left light sensor reads 100 %
equivalence_partitions.dimension: the light from above at the robot

expected_results: It follows the line and reaches Goal 1 at the line's end.

postconditions.description: By the end of the run, the robot has touched Goal 1 at the line's end.

assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.

tests.reason: You said the robot should follow the line, so this shows whether it gets along the line to its end in the light.

worlds.name: A line through a dark tunnel

tests.name: Follows the line through the tunnel
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts on the line inside a dark tunnel, where the light from above is dim, when the program runs, then it follows the line through the tunnel to Goal 1 without bumping into the tunnel's walls.

equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: A stands in the middle of a 15 cm wide tunnel, about 15 cm inside its opening, where the light from above reads 40 %
equivalence_partitions.dimension: the light from above at the robot

expected_results: It follows the line through the dark tunnel and reaches Goal 1 in it.

postconditions.description: By the end of the run, the robot has touched Goal 1 inside the tunnel.
During the whole run, it never bumps into the tunnel's walls.

assumptions: The line runs on through the tunnel, and its far end is where the robot should get to.

tests.reason: In dim light you said the robot should follow the line, and this test puts the line in a tunnel, where the light is dim.
